card.name: Start of dilution and anticoagulant words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word split in two, such as dil in diluent or dilution, ag in anticoagulant, Anal in analgesic, Ant in antivenin, and Sh in shampoo. It appears in dosing and preparation text.

modes.label: Dilution words
modes.description: The start of diluent or dilution after a word like this or 1:1.
modes.example: Each mL of this<< dil>>ution contains 1 mcg of ep

modes.label: Anticoagulant
modes.description: The ag piece inside anticoagulant when switching from one anticoagulant to another.
modes.example: For adult and pediatric patients currently receiving a parenteral antico<<ag>>ulant, start dabigatran et

modes.label: Other drug class words
modes.description: The opening piece of a class or product word such as analgesic, antivenin or shampoo.
modes.example: Use of Levorphanol Tartrate Tablets as the First Opioid<< Anal>>gesic Initiate treatment with Levor

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are unrelated to the text pattern.
card.plain: It fires partway through words like diluent, dilution and anticoagulant, right before the word is completed.
